faqs.question: Which GHRU campus is the agriculture course at?
faqs.answer: The official course overview identifies GHRU Saikheda. The audited institution name retains Chhindwara.

faqs.question: What is the duration and mode?
faqs.answer: The official programme page specifies four years, eight semesters and full-time study.

faqs.question: Which school qualifications are listed?
faqs.answer: The undated university page lists PCM, PCB, PCMB or Crop Science with category-based thresholds. NTA’s matching table is for 2025; confirm current rules.

faqs.question: Is a verified 2026 fee available here?
faqs.answer: No. A secondary calculated fee total was found, but no dated official tuition schedule was verified.

faqs.question: When does the audited ICAR term end?
faqs.answer: It runs from 9 November 2021 through 8 November 2026. A later renewal must be checked separately.

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at GHRU?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practice field: The university describes a field available for agriculture students’ practical learning.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for GHRU?
faqs.answer: https://admissions.ghru.edu.in/. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact GHRU?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: +91 91110 42900; Public email: info@ghru.edu.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at GHRU?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/g-h-raisoni-university-chhindwara/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GHRU?
faqs.answer: 4 years (8 semesters); study format: Full time. The four-year full-time degree spans agricultural microbiology, soils, genetics and plant breeding, plant pathology and related subjects. The university describes field practice, projects and study tours.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GHRU?
faqs.answer: The undated university course page lists 12th Science in PCM/PCB/PCMB/Crop Science with 45% for open and 40% for reserved categories. NTA’s 2025 table repeats those thresholds; 2026 conditions need confirmation.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GHRU?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to GHRU work?
faqs.answer: The course page links to the university application portal. Its eligibility thresholds are corroborated by an NTA table explicitly for 2025, so they are not treated as a verified 2026 policy. Ask admissions to confirm the applicable selection route and subject eligibility for the new cycle. Confirm the current prospectus: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application. Request a written cost statement: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for GHRU?
faqs.answer: G H Raisoni University, Chhindwara: •B.Sc.(Hons) Agriculture (Intake- 120)*, recorded term 2021-11-09 to 2026-11-08. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at GHRU?
faqs.answer: The degree page identifies field trips, study tours and projects as practical elements.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at GHRU?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practice field: The university describes a field available for agriculture students’ practical learning.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for GHRU?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practice field: The university describes a field available for agriculture students’ practical learning.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for GHRU?
faqs.answer: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for GHRU was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for GHRU?
faqs.answer: The agriculture page lists potential sectors such as agricultural production, food processing and input industries. These are career possibilities, not a dated GHRU placement result. No agriculture-specific employer or salary statistics were verified.

faqs.question: How can I contact GHRU about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91 91110 42900. Published email: info@ghru.edu.in. Official admissions: https://admissions.ghru.edu.in/

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for GHRU?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://admissions.ghru.edu.in/; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
